facts.speed: 299,792.458 km/s in vacuum (exact, by SI definition of the metre).
facts.earth: Equatorial circumference 40,075 km; 299,792 / 40,075 = 7.48 laps per second.
facts.sun: Mean Sun-Earth distance 149.6 million km; 149.6e6 / 299,792 = 499 s = 8 min 19 s.
facts.proxima: Proxima Centauri, nearest star after the Sun, is 4.24 light-years away.

lines.text: Light is the fastest thing in the universe.
lines.spoken: Light is the fastest thing in the universe.

lines.text: It covers about 300,000 kilometres every second.
lines.spoken: It covers about three hundred thousand kilometres every second.

lines.text: Fast enough to circle the Earth seven and a half times.
lines.spoken: Fast enough to circle the Earth seven and a half times.

lines.text: Yet sunlight still needs eight minutes to reach us.
lines.spoken: Yet sunlight still needs eight minutes to reach us.

lines.text: Light from the nearest other star takes over four years.
lines.spoken: Light from the nearest other star takes over four years.

lines.text: So every time you look up, you are seeing the past.
lines.spoken: So every time you look up, you are seeing the past.
